title: Educational simulation
detail: Local Hardhat EVM. Synthetic grain batches. No payments, tokens or real assets.

title: 1. Contract deployed
detail:
AgriChainRegistry: 0x5FbDB2315678afecb367f032d93F642f64180aa3
Network: hardhat, chain ID 31337. Four separate business test accounts.

title: 2. Batch registered
detail: Custodian registers G001: Wheat, 100,000 kg. Status REGISTERED.

title: 3. Document fingerprint stored
detail:
Fingerprint: 0x555e5cac55e0cad1b72cd06e8f23b2836df482927b523acf21d2c2fe47ecbede
A changed file has a different hash. This does not certify the original document.

title: 5. Receipt confirmed
detail: A different receiver account confirms receipt. Status RECEIVED.

title: 6. Invalid split rejected
detail: 50,000 + 40,000 does not equal 100,000 kg. Contract returns QUANTITY_MISMATCH.

title: 7. Valid split recorded
detail: G001A and G001B each contain 50,000 kg. Each child points to G001. Parent status SPLIT.

title: 8. Issue resolved
detail: Reviewer appends an issue and resolution. Event history remains available.

title: 9. Access control checked
detail: An unrelated test account cannot register a batch. Contract returns ACCESS_DENIED.
